menu.trtr.knapping_hint: Keep the outlined blade. Chip away the surrounding flint.
menu.trtr.knapping_ruined: Blade damaged. Start with new flint.
message.trtr.knapping_no_flint: No flint or flint shards in your inventory
message.trtr.fire_needs_dry_campfire: Find an unlit campfire sheltered from rain and water
message.trtr.fire_needs_tinder: Hold a tinder bundle in your other hand
message.trtr.fire_lit: Fire lit! Use a stick on the fire to make a torch.
tooltip.trtr.flint: Use to open knapping and shape a flint blade
tooltip.trtr.fiber: Craft 3 into cord or 4 into tinder. Mature wheat also yields fiber.
tooltip.trtr.knife: Use on an unstripped log for sticks; use with raw hide in the other hand to scrape it
tooltip.trtr.fire_drill: Hold tinder in the other hand; aim at an unlit campfire and hold Use for 4 seconds
tooltip.trtr.hide: Use a flint knife in the other hand to scrape this hide
tooltip.trtr.drying: Hang scraped hide on a rack; keep it out of rain for 30 seconds, then collect
